title: Protocol for amplification of three DNA regions from Nephila clavipes (Araneae: Araneidae).
author: Luiz Filipe Bartoleti

steps_raw.instruction: Protocol for amplification of three DNA regions from Nephila clavipes (Araneae: Araneidae).

Reference: Folmer, O., Black, M., Hoeh, W., Lutz, R., Vrijenhoek, R. (1994) DNA primers for amplification of mitochondrial cytochrome c oxidase subunit I from diverse metazoan invertebrates. Molecular Marine Biology and Biotechnology, 3(5), 294–299.

PCR Reaction: 1μL of template DNA, 1U of Taq DNA Polymerase (Thermo-Fisher), 2.5μL of 10X KCl Buffer (Thermo-Fisher), 2.8μL of 25mM MgCl2 (Thermo-Fisher), 1μL of 10mM dNTP mix (GE Healthcare), 0.5μL of each forward and reverse primer 10μM, and ddH2O to the volume of 25μL.

PCR cycling: a denaturation step of 3 min at 94ºC, 30 cycles of a denaturation step at 94ºC for 45s, an annealing step at 51ºC for 45s and an extension step at 72ºC for 2 min, and a final extension step at 72ºC for 3 min.
Nuclear gene for the subunit a of the Histone 3 (H3a)
Reference: Colgan, D.J., McLauchlan, A., Wilson, G.D.F. et al. (1998) Histone H3 and U2 snRNA DNA sequences and arthropod molecular evolution. Australian Journal of Zoology, 46, 419–437.

PCR Reaction: 1μL of template DNA, 1U of Taq DNA Polymerase (Thermo-Fisher), 2.5μL of 10X KCl Buffer (Thermo-Fisher), 2.3μL of 25mM MgCl2 (Thermo-Fisher), 0.5μL of 10mM dNTP mix (GE Healthcare), 0.5μL of each forward and reverse primer 10μM, and ddH2O to the volume of 25μL.

PCR cycling: a denaturation step of 3-4 min at 94ºC, 30 cycles of a denaturation step at 94ºC for 45s, an annealing step at 46ºC for 1 min and an extension step at 72ºC for 1 min, and a final extension step at 72ºC for 10 min.

Reference: White, T.J., Bruns, T., Lee, S., Taylor, J. (1990) Amplification and direct sequencing of fungal ribosomal RNA genes for phylogenetics. In: Innis MA, Gelfand DH, Sninsky JJ, et al., eds. PCR Protocols: A Guide to Methods and Applications. New York: Academic Press, 315–322.

PCR Reaction: 1μL of template DNA, 1U of Taq DNA Polymerase (Thermo-Fisher), 2.5μL of 10X KCl Buffer (Thermo-Fisher), 3.5μL of 25mM MgCl2 (Thermo-Fisher), 0.5μL of 10mM dNTP mix (GE Healthcare), 0.4μL of each forward and reverse primer 10μM, and ddH2O to the volume of 25μL.

PCR cycling: a denaturation step of 4 min at 95ºC, 30 cycles of a denaturation step at 95ºC for 45s, an annealing step at 61ºC for 45s and an extension step at 72ºC for 2 min, and a final extension step at 72ºC for 10 min.
